found.value: Change in force: GDBA and BFFS terminated the NV Bühne to 30 June 2026. Under TVG § 4 (5) its norms continue until replaced; from 1 July 2026 employers may agree deviating terms with new NV Bühne staff (Bühnenverein FAQ, 25 Feb 2026).
